TUTORIAL_BODY_1:
Mana is the resource spent on Chant. Playing Mana from your Hand is called Synchro: draw 1 card, then Exhaust the Mana.

Your starting relic, Holy Emblem, adds 1 Mana to your Draw Pile and Discard Pile at the start of each turn.

The counters beside Mana show how much Mana is in your Draw Pile, Hand, and Discard Pile.
TUTORIAL_BODY_2:
You have three slots for Magic Factors. Each Factor describes the cost and reward of a Chant.

For Chant 1, replace X with 1. Choose any pile that has enough Mana to pay its Factor. Only that pile pays.

The Factors shown cost X, 2X, and 6X Mana. For Chant 2, you need 2 Mana in your Draw Pile, 4 in your Hand, or 12 in your Discard Pile.
TUTORIAL_BODY_3:
Click the Magic Deck [img=32x32]res://FrierenMod/images/ui/magic_deck.png[/img] icon in the top right to view your Factors and Tools.

Right-click a Tool, then left-click its targets to use it. Right-click the selected Tool again or press Esc to cancel.

Combat rewards may include new Factors and Tools. In the Magic Deck [img=32x32]res://FrierenMod/images/ui/magic_deck.png[/img], click Tutorial to review these instructions, or Achievements & Card Backs to change your slot backgrounds.

“Wow, what a tall tower!”

Just as you are looking forward to exploring another labyrinth, the three grimoires in your suitcase begin to [shake]stir[/shake]. Perhaps the great whale nearby has something to do with it…
Choose an initial [gold]Magic Factor[/gold] for each of your three slots.

“Wow, what a tall tower!”

Just as you are looking forward to exploring another labyrinth, the three grimoires in your suitcase begin to [shake]stir[/shake]. Perhaps the great whale nearby has something to do with it…
Choose an initial [gold]Magic Factor[/gold] for your [gold]draw slot[/gold].

You feel the [gold]Mana[/gold] flowing within you [wave]begin to change[/wave]…

The draw slot is ready. Two grimoires remain.
Choose an initial [gold]Magic Factor[/gold] for your [gold]hand slot[/gold].

You feel the [gold]Mana[/gold] flowing within you [wave]begin to change[/wave]…

The hand slot is ready, too. Just one grimoire left.
Choose an initial [gold]Magic Factor[/gold] for your [gold]discard slot[/gold].

After examining the grimoires, you notice that some of your [gold]Mana[/gold] has [wave]taken shape[/wave].

With all three grimoires checked, you find a few Magic Tools in your suitcase.
You pack away the three grimoires and your [gold]two Unbelievable Tools[/gold], eager to enter the Spire.
Continue to the great whale’s blessing.
